A '''Sith''' functioned as the servant to the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Simus]] after the latter's [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitation]] during a [[Duel between Marka Ragnos and Simus|duel]] against [[Marka Ragnos]] for the position of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. A member of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the servant was relied upon by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Simus for transportation during the [[Golden Age of the Sith]] until the warlord's death who died after [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], Simus' [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] shot the warlord, the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt also pierced through the servant.<ref name="Golden Age 3" />
